entries.camera: Long-lens 135mm shot at knee height through blurred glowing flowers in the foreground, shallow depth of field, the figure sharp in the middle distance.
entries.subject: A cloaked figure seen from behind steps into a tall arch of two bent birch trees at the end of a moonlit forest path, already half-gone in a spiral of silver mist, as if caught mid-teleport. A ring of luminous toadstools glows on the path before the arch. Glittering fey light blooms outward from the figure's open hands. In the blurred foreground, oversized glowing blossoms, drifting petals, spores and fireflies frame the shot.
entries.accent: twilight lilac and moonlit silver with spring-green sparkles

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, wide lens, the black sea filling the whole frame around the jetty.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at the tip of a weathered stone jetty reaching into a black night sea, a hooded figure standing at its end, seen from above. From the water around the jetty a vast tentacle of translucent living seawater rises and coils in a protective spiral around the figure without touching them, lit from inside by drifting bioluminescent patterns, droplets frozen in the air. Concentric ripples spread across the dark sea, and pale glowing shapes of the deep drift far below the surface.

entries.camera: Extreme macro side-on close-up at floor level, very shallow depth of field, the crossguard and the lower blade in sharp focus running across the frame.
entries.subject: A black longsword planted point-down in a cracked flagstone, its dark blade etched with curving non-legible glyph shapes that glow along the fuller. A bruise-purple smoke pours off the edge and rises behind the sword into the outline of a hollow, translucent suit of plate armour with an empty helmet, standing motionless in soft focus. A small star-shaped hex mark burns on the crossguard. Ash and sparks float in the air.
entries.accent: black steel and bruise-purple smoke with a thin white-hot edge

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) shot from sand level, wide lens, the vessel large in the foreground and the smoke towering over it.
entries.subject: An ornate brass-and-enamel vessel with a long curved spout and an open hinged lid stands on a rippled desert dune at sunset. A huge column of smoke and sparks pours out of it and rises into the vast, faceless torso of a genie with crossed arms, its lower body a tail of swirling smoke traced with glowing embers. Through the open neck of the vessel glints a tiny lantern-lit chamber with silk cushions and a patterned carpet.
entries.accent: sunset coral-orange and burnished brass with sapphire smoke

entries.camera: Medium-wide backlit silhouette shot from behind at eye level, long lens, the low sun directly ahead of the figure.
entries.subject: A figure seen from behind stands in a ruined garden of grey wilted flowers and dry grass, silhouetted against a low rising sun. Great wings of pure white light unfold from the figure's back, loose feathers drifting away as sparks. One raised open hand holds a small star of warm healing light. Where the glow touches the ground, a wave of green shoots and blooming flowers spreads out from the figure's feet, turning the dead grey plants vivid.
entries.accent: radiant white and pale gold with a hint of rose-pink dawn

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from just behind the figure's left shoulder, 35mm, the figure dark in the foreground and the crypt door in focus.
entries.subject: A hooded figure in a long black cloak lined with raven feathers, seen from behind, faces the great stone door of a crypt standing ajar. The door is carved with skull motifs, and pale mist spills over the threshold across withered flowers and dead leaves. Behind the figure the cloak lifts and unfurls into a vast shroud of pale mist and torn shadow, ghostly motes rising from it. Rows of candles gutter along the walls.
entries.accent: cold bone-white and sickly grey-green mist

entries.camera: Side-on close-up still life at table level, 85mm, shallow depth of field, the hourglass sharp and the dim crypt blurred behind.
entries.subject: On a worn stone slab stands an ancient brass hourglass with cracked glass, its sand flowing upward from the lower bulb to the upper one, a thin glittering stream frozen in mid-air. Beside it lies a rose half restored: one side grey and crumbling to dust, the other fresh and in full bloom with dewdrops. A single bright green shoot pushes up through a crack in the slab. Cobwebs and drifting dust motes catch a thin shaft of light.
entries.accent: dusty umber and parchment beige with one vivid green shoot

entries.camera: Low-angle shot from the cracked stone at the lip of the chasm looking up, wide lens, the figure towering against the fire.
entries.subject: A caped figure seen from behind stands at the lip of a cracked black-stone chasm, one hand lifted. A funnel of hellfire spins up out of the chasm, black iron chains and glowing embers orbiting it, a huge arch-shaped gate of molten light burning in its core. A circle of abstract non-legible glyph shapes burns in the floor around the figure's feet. The long shadow on the stone carries the faint outline of curling horns.
entries.accent: hellfire crimson with black ash and sulphur-yellow sparks

entries.camera: Extreme wide shot from far behind, the figure a tiny dark speck on a vast flat plain, the sky filling nearly the whole frame.
entries.subject: A lone tiny figure, seen from behind, stands on a limitless salt flat at night, covered by a thin sheet of water that mirrors the sky. Above the horizon the heavens have torn open into a colossal iris-shaped aperture of slow-swirling starlight and liquid light, with pale threads of glow hanging down like drifting seaweed. The stars around it bend into unnatural spirals. Faint concentric ripples spread from the figure's feet through the mirror.
entries.accent: midnight indigo-black with a pallid yellow-white glare

entries.camera: High-angle three-quarter view from a broken balcony looking down into a ruined hall, long lens, the shard sharp and the floor fading into dark.
entries.subject: In the cracked marble floor of a ruined, overgrown hall lies a huge faceted crystal shard, a fragment of a long-dead god's heart, an ember-orange glow pulsing in its core with thin cracks of light running through it. A cloaked figure kneels beside it, seen from behind, one hand resting on the shard. From the crystal rises a translucent faceless echo of a vast outstretched hand and mantle, dissolving like smoke through the broken roof, while a small pale spirit wisp drifts at the figure's shoulder.
entries.accent: pearl-grey ghost-light and rust-ochre with a faint ember core
